summary.text: Robert Murray Jr., a Republican chosen by his party at a July caucus, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Virginia's 4th Congressional District to Democratic incumbent Jennifer McClellan.
He received 26.2% of the vote to Jennifer McClellan's 72.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Little biographical information about him is available in public sources reviewed for this guide.
